title: Card Obscure — big UI redesign update
author: Several_Zone1796
selftext:
Hey r/AIGameDev,

Posted here a while back about Card Obscure, my AI-assisted hobby card game 

project. Since then I did a complete redesign of the entire UI and wanted to 

share the progress.



The old version worked but never had a consistent visual style. The new 

direction goes for a darker, grounded aesthetic — bronze and copper tones, 

sharp edges, no rounded bubbles or generic neon gradients. Every screen got 

reworked from scratch.



What changed in this update:

\- Full UI redesign across all screens — dashboard, shop, battle, collection, 

  ranking, settings

\- New fixed 1280x720 base layout with scale-to-fit for all screen sizes

\- Adventure mode chapter 1 is now playable with cinematic story scenes

\- 30 unique opponents with AI-generated avatars across 5 factions

\- VS screen before every match with character quotes

\- Lucky Slice wheel redesigned in a steampunk style



AI usage in this project:

Card artwork and all character avatars are AI generated. Code was built with 

Claude as an assistant — I describe what I want, learn from the output and 

make all the design decisions myself. No coding background, purely a hobby.



[Itch.io](http://Itch.io) Link= [Card Obscure von card-obscure](https://card-obscure.itch.io/card-obscure)



Still early access — more adventure content coming soon. 

Feedback always welcome.
